# gezor_sso_domain (Resource)

An email domain that signs in through SSO. Publish `txt_record` at `txt_host` in DNS, then verify the domain in the portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gezor_sso_domain" "acme" {
  domain      = "acme.com"
  provider_id = gezor_sso_provider.entra.id
}

output "dns_txt" {
  value = "${gezor_sso_domain.acme.txt_host} TXT ${gezor_sso_domain.acme.txt_record}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Email domain, for example `example.com`.

### Optional

- `provider_id` (String) SSO provider for this domain.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `domain`.
- `txt_host` (String)
- `txt_record` (String) DNS TXT value proving ownership.
- `verified` (Boolean)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Append @<workspace> to import from a workspace other than the provider default.
terraform import gezor_sso_domain.example acme.com
```
